reel.cLead: The prefix jumps to the end of the sentence:

caption:
German verbs that split in half 😅

'aufstehen' (to get up) is a separable verb — the 'auf' flies to the end of the sentence:
Ich stehe um 7 Uhr auf. = I get up at 7.
